atoms.text: Aoife wants to show you around the cities in Northern Ireland. Will you visit some cities with her?

instruction.text: Aoife wants to know if you recognise what Northern Irish towns and cities look like. Select the images of towns and cities in Northern Ireland.

feedback.end: Northern Ireland has only 6 cities. Over a third of the population live in Belfast and its surrounding area.
feedback.wrong: This is Santorini in Greece. Northern Irish buildings are usually made from brick.

instruction.text: Aoife asks if you know what you might find in Northern Irish towns and cities. Drag the images to the correct words.
Aoife has marked a few of Northern Ireland’s biggest cities on her map. Find Derry on the map to visit it.
This is Derry. Find the river in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: Derry is famous for its old walls that you can walk the whole way around the city on.

instruction.text: Find Lisburn on the map to visit it.
This is Lisburn. Find the street in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: Lisburn is the third-largest city in Northern Ireland. It was a global centre of linen production in the 18th century.

instruction.text: Find Newry on the map to visit it.
This is Newry. Find the bridge in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: Newry is a small city with an old canal, which was once the first in Ireland to connect two separate river valleys.
